players.product: 3D wafer-bump, wire-bonding and memory-module vision inspection systems (HBM inspection)

quarterly_data.signal: IR deck (September 2026; image-only pages): H1 2026 consolidated cumulative revenue of 409 (KRW 100 million), of which SMT inspection equipment 73.2% and semiconductor inspection equipment 26.8% (page 4 chart); the deck describes the semiconductor segment as inspection of high-quality chips such as HBM, FC-BGA and FC-CSP, 'the semiconductor area at the core of AI and HPC technology', with the 8800WIR [HBM], MARS, ZEUS and APOLLON systems. Annual revenue shown: 2023 735, 2024 570, 2025 698 (KRW 100 million; page 9 chart); exports 2023 550, 2024 416, 2025 435 (KRW 100 million; page 16 chart).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue 409 (KRW 100 million): SMT 73.2%, semiconductor 26.8%; 2025 revenue 698, exports 435

quarterly_data.signal: Company timeline in the IR deck (page 6 chart): 2023.05 customer mass-production approval for the 3D memory-module automatic inspection system MARS; 2023.07 a 1,600-pyeong site secured in the Yongin semiconductor cluster; 2025.12 a domestic foundry inspection-equipment order confirmed (customer not named). R&D base (page 13 chart, end-2025): 143 specialist researchers, 54.3% of staff (software 90, hardware 53), R&D investment above 17% of 2025 revenue, more than 80 patents registered (applications included) and production facilities of more than 2,000 pyeong (expanded in 2021); 268 employees as of H1 2026 (page 8).
quarterly_data.figure: Yongin site 1,600 pyeong; 143 researchers (54.3%); R&D above 17% of 2025 revenue; 268 employees

quarterly_data.signal: Customer plan in the IR deck (page 18 chart): a 'new global customer network expansion plan' shows Samsung, Foxconn and Jabil for SMT inspection and Samsung, CXMT, Powertech Technology and BPIL for semiconductor inspection (targets, not stated customers); planned moves are a focus on large customers, expansion into the new AI semiconductor industry, wider cooperation with global OSATs and semiconductor back-end process cooperation with 'company S'. The company's stated vision is to be the global No.1 in advanced 3D inspection equipment (company claim).

The same customer slide (page 18 chart, logo list) also names Nepes, SFA and Kingston Technology among existing semiconductor-inspection customers, and Huawei, Kimball, Sumida, Flex, Inventec, Siemens and Continental among existing SMT-inspection customers.
